About the job

About The Role

Drive Operational Excellence

DecisionPoint Corporation is seeking a reliable and organized Operations Manager to help support daily business activities and keep operations running smoothly.

In this role, you will assist with coordinating tasks, maintaining records, supporting communication across teams, and helping ensure projects stay on track.

This position offers a flexible hybrid work environment and is ideal for individuals who are organized, detail-oriented, and enjoy working with people.

Key Responsibilities

What You'll Do

As an Operations Manager, you will help support the day-to-day activities of the organization.

Coordinate daily operational tasks and activities
Track project timelines and deadlines
Schedule meetings and maintain calendars
Maintain reports and business records
Support communication between teams
Assist with task coordination and follow-ups
Monitor project progress and provide updates
Help improve workflows and processes
Support managers with administrative duties
Ensure company procedures are followed

Requirements

What We're Looking For

We welcome applicants from a variety of professional backgrounds.

Required Qualifications

Must currently reside in the United States
Strong communication skills
Good organizational skills
Ability to manage multiple tasks
Basic computer proficiency
Attention to detail
Professional attitude
Ability to work independently and as part of a team

Preferred Qualifications

Previous office, administrative, customer service, or operations experience
Experience working in a hybrid or remote environment

Training is available for qualified candidates.
